representative_papers.title: Single-View Holographic Volumetric 3D Printing with Coupled Differentiable Wave-Optical and Photochemical Optimization
representative_papers.problem: Volumetric 3D printing micro-scale fidelity challenged by complex optical diffraction and chemical effects
representative_papers.approach: Couple differentiable wave-optical forward model with photochemical model capturing inhibitor diffusion
representative_papers.contribution: Hologram synthesis achieving ~10 micron lateral resolution via pre-compensating for chemical blur

representative_papers.title: Untangling Surfaces via Shape and Mesh Repulsion
representative_papers.problem: Self-intersections in meshes break downstream simulation, fabrication, and learning pipelines
representative_papers.approach: Energy-based framework enforcing embeddedness at both shape and mesh levels
representative_papers.contribution: Reliable self-intersection removal via global shape and local mesh repulsion energies

representative_papers.title: AtomSlicer: Constant-Thickness Field-Aligned Non-Planar Slicing and Continuous Toolpaths for FFF
representative_papers.problem: Multi-axis 3D printing requires continuous collision-free toolpaths with constant bead geometry
representative_papers.approach: Field-aligned phase fields partitioned into layers with 2-RoSy-aligned toolpath synthesis
representative_papers.contribution: Reduces travel moves by 1-2 orders of magnitude while preserving field constraints and constant thickness
